releaseName: Faster live replies and interview texts in French
summary: Live interview replies come sooner. A short spoken acknowledgement plays while the interviewer writes, and the question plays sentence by sentence as its audio arrives (#2409). Each turn logs how long recognition, the interviewer and the voice took, with no words or audio. Talk live now opens on the signed-in screen as well as the owner screen (#2393). The career interview now speaks the screen's language throughout: topic reasons and the opening offer are worded on the screen, the interviewer's fixed sentences follow the conversation's language, and a confirmed topic's evidence file has French headings and labels on a French screen (#2418 to #2420).
knownLimitations: The interviewer's question is still written in one call before it is spoken; streaming it into the voice waits on the turn timings. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The screening shadow only logs. Live speech and the career interview still need DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key on staging. Topics saved before this release show a neutral sentence instead of their full reason, and evidence files already confirmed stay in English. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
